command:
.venv/bin/python -c "
import csv, io
old = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO('a,b\nx,  y  \n')))
new = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO('a,b\nx,  y  \n'), skipinitialspace=True))
print('old unquoted :', old[1])
print('new unquoted :', new[1])
old_q = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO('a,b\nx,\"  y  \"\n')))
new_q = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO('a,b\nx,\"  y  \"\n'), skipinitialspace=True))
print('old in-quotes:', old_q[1])
print('new in-quotes:', new_q[1])
"
title: Verify space semantics old vs new parser
